item.title: Indoor Tanning Makes Youthful Skin Much Older on a Genetic Level
item.description:
📝 The skin of tanning bed users was riddled with the seeds of cancer — cells with mutations known to lead to melanoma. The young tanning bed users had more skin mutations than people twice their age, especially in their lower backs, an area that does not get much damage from sunlight but has a great deal of exposure from tanning beds. “The skin of tanning bed users was riddled with the seeds of cancer — cells with mutations known to lead to melanoma,” said senior author A.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ucsf.edu/news/2025/12/431206/indoor-tanning-makes-youthful-skin-much-older-genetic-level

item.title: Isengard in Oxford
item.description:
📝 Tolkien’s long-lost satire of a motorized world. Tolkien are used to dealing with fragments. Anyone who has read Tolkien’s letters will know that he is at his funniest when filled with rage, and The Bovadium Fragments is a work brimming with Tolkien’s fury—specifically, ire over mankind’s obsession with motor vehicles.
🔗 Read more: https://lareviewofbooks.org/article/isengard-in-oxford/

item.title: Inca Stone Masonry
item.description:
📝 This collection of early Spanish references presents a detailed picture of how their impressive stonework was accomplished. While the Inca didn’t have a complete written language, they did have wise elders in their society whose primary role was to recall and pass down their history. With these records, they tracked tribute payments from their conquered villages (akin to taxes).
🔗 Read more: https://www.earthasweknowit.com/pages/inca_construction
